structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Copper, aluminium and lithium are infrastructure/electrification inputs and already contribute more than half of disclosed underlying EBITDA.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Commodity diversification reduces single-commodity dependence, but major-project economics and commodity cycles remain material.

structural-causal.name: supplyChainResilience
structural-causal.basis: AP60 adds aluminium capacity and Winu could broaden copper supply, but Winu is not yet an operating asset.

discovery-weak-signals.name: critical-mineral diversification
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Primary results show non-iron-ore commodities above half of underlying EBITDA.

discovery-weak-signals.name: project social license
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Winu project agreement provides concrete consent/governance evidence.

discovery-weak-signals.name: financialOperatingMomentum
discovery-weak-signals.basis: 2025 EBITDA and operating cash flow increased while disclosed operating unit costs declined; H1/Q2 2026 operating updates show copper/iron-ore/lithium volume progress and lower copper unit-cost guidance.

discovery-weak-signals.name: catalystScore
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Rincon has external project financing and a dated 2028 first-production checkpoint, while 2026 operating updates provide measurable ramp milestones.

discovery-weak-signals.name: supplyChainResilience
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Copper, iron ore, aluminium and lithium operating/ramp evidence spans multiple commodity systems and geographies.

adversarial-red-team.name: commodityCycle
adversarial-red-team.basis: Cash generation remains sensitive to commodity prices despite diversification.

adversarial-red-team.name: confidenceInflation
adversarial-red-team.basis: Commissioning and consent milestones are concrete; extrapolation to full ramp and project returns remains prospective.

expectations-execution.name: productivity conversion
expectations-execution.basis: Benefits are partly realized rather than solely targeted.

expectations-execution.name: capacity ramp
expectations-execution.basis: Commissioning is underway but completion remains prospective.

items.risk: Commodity prices and major-project execution can materially alter cash generation.

Successor bottlenecks can shift from resource availability to permitting, social license, project execution, power and commodity economics.
Commodity-price weakness or cost inflation can offset productivity and capacity gains.
Large projects can consume capital before economic output is proven.
Commodity-price sensitivity and high capital intensity can offset volume and productivity gains.
Rincon's 2028 start and subsequent ramp remain prospective execution checkpoints.
Rincón remains a greenfield development; financing and lender investment do not prove schedule, full ramp, realized operating economics or commodity-price resilience.
